chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd ibn 'Abdullah narrated to me, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran and al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad ibn 'Isa, from Hariz ibn 'Abdullah al-Sijistani, from Aban ibn Taghlub, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both): He said:
Whoever among the believers dies between the decline of the sun on Thursday and the decline of the sun on Friday, God will protect him from the pressure of the grave.

key_terms.زوال الشمس: The decline of the sun from its zenith, marking the onset of the noon (Dhuhr) prayer time
key_terms.ضغطة القبر: The pressure/squeezing of the grave — an eschatological trial that the deceased faces after burial

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of dying between Thursday midday and Friday midday in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) teaches that a believer who dies in the blessed period between midday Thursday and midday Friday receives divine protection from the torment of the grave. This teaching reflects the special sanctity of Friday (Jumu'ah) in Islam, which extends backward into Thursday afternoon, a time traditionally associated with increased blessings. The 'pressure of the grave' (daghtat al-qabr) is a well-known concept in Islamic eschatology referring to the initial constriction the deceased experiences in the grave.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan (rh) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to me from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Khalid from `Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Najran and al-Husayn b. Sa`id from Hammad b. `Isa from Hariz b. `Abdullah al-Sijistani from Aban b. Taghlub from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:
Whoever among the believers dies between after midday on Thursday and midday on Friday, Allah will safeguard him from the pressure of the grave.
